2608.24559.title: COCI: Conference Organisers and Content Identifier
2608.24559.paper_summary: Despite the critical role of grey literature in scholarly communication, artefacts such as Calls for Papers (CfPs) remain largely isolated from modern Scholarly Knowledge Graphs. The unstructured and highly heterogeneous nature of these documents has traditionally hindered their large-scale processing. In this demo paper, we present the Conference Organisers and Content Identifier (COCI), an AI-based framework designed to extract fine-grained, structured metadata from raw CfP texts. COCI employs a multi-stage pipeline that combines Large Language Models (LLMs) with semantic mapping techniques to integrate extracted entities with established knowledge bases, including OpenAlex, DBLP, TIB ConfIDent, and the AIDA Dashboard. By disambiguating authors and semantically aligning topics and conference series, COCI bridges the gap between informal scholarly dissemination and structured Semantic Web resources, laying the foundation for systematic analysis of non-publisher-based academic events.
2608.24559.paper_summary_zh: 儘管灰色文獻在學術交流中扮演著關鍵角色，但像徵文徵集（CfPs）這類文獻仍然在現代學術知識圖譜中大多處於孤立狀態。這些文檔的非結構化和高度異質性特徵傳統上阻礙了它們的大規模處理。在這篇示範論文中，我們介紹了會議組織者和內容識別器（COCI），這是一個基於人工智慧的框架，旨在從原始CfP文本中提取細粒度的結構化元數據。COCI採用多階段管道，將大型語言模型（LLMs）與語義映射技術相結合，以將提取的實體與既有知識庫整合，包括OpenAlex、DBLP、TIB ConfIDent和AIDA儀表板。通過消歧義作者並語義對齊主題和會議系列，COCI彌合了非正式學術傳播與結構化語義網資源之間的鴻溝，為系統分析非出版商主導的學術活動奠定了基礎。
